The SealedSecret CRD API group is 'bitnami.com/v1alpha1', not 'k8s.io'. The kubeseal CLI fetches the controller's public cert automatically — you do not need to pass --cert manually if kubectl is pointed at kind-dojo.

Use --dry-run=client -o yaml to generate the plaintext Secret manifest WITHOUT applying it. Feed that to kubeseal via stdin: kubeseal --format=yaml < plaintext.yaml > sealed.yaml. Then kubectl apply -f sealed.yaml (the SealedSecret, not the plaintext).

The verifier checks the ownerReference on the Secret to confirm it was created by the controller (not manually applied). If you see 'Secret exists but ownerReference.kind != SealedSecret', you accidentally applied the plaintext manifest. Delete it, apply the SealedSecret instead, and retry.
